verdict.rationale: The evidence describes Spline as a cloud-based, browser-run design tool whose files live in Spline's cloud. Its "Self-Hosted" export only packages an individual project and the Spline runtime as a ZIP; that is adjacent scene export, not self-hosting the editor or platform. Nothing in the pack mentions an open-source license or a deployable server for the platform itself.

support.subject: As a developer, I can self-host the full design platform on my own infrastructure under an open-source license
